Gaolan.why: Builds data-center liquid-cooling systems (cold-plate and immersion CDUs, piping / manifolds, cold plates, immersion tanks); AI computing liquid-cooling projects drove its H1 2026 growth, so AI data-center build-out directly lifts its revenue.
Gaolan.evidence: Gaolan half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026): high-power-density device thermal management = data-center liquid-cooling products incl. cold-plate and immersion solutions (room CDUs, piping and manifolds); revenue rose as AI computing-center liquid-cooling projects landed in volume; segment revenue RMB 210,110,127.68, up 53.41%.

players.product: Data-center liquid-cooling systems on the facility side (cold-plate and immersion: CDUs, secondary-side piping and manifolds, server cold plates, fluid connectors, immersion tanks; pump-driven two-phase cold-plate system in development) for leading internet companies and IDC operators, alongside HVDC converter-valve and energy-storage liquid cooling

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record, H1 2026 online results briefing): H1 2026 overall gross margin was 26.12%, up 1.51% year on year, and product profitability improved. Net profit attributable to shareholders grew more slowly than revenue mainly because of higher minority interests (the controlled subsidiary Lantian Technology performed better), lower government subsidies and higher income-tax expense; the company will keep optimizing its product mix to raise gross margin and control expenses. H1 2026 overseas revenue came mainly from high-power-density device thermal management products; the company does not yet break out orders in hand or segment revenue by business line. The Saudi project is progressing in an orderly way.

Management (IR record): the company will keep increasing R&D investment under its dual-track model (Gaolan Energy-Saving Research Institute plus design offices), and its R&D focuses on high-barrier technologies: AI high-power liquid cooling, two-phase cold-plate and two-phase immersion liquid cooling.
